dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABIDE I and ABIDE II collections of the ABIDE initiative.

answer.ABIDE (I+II): normative training on non-ASD males (80% of controls, n=321); testing/validation on remaining non-ASD males (n=77) and ASD males (n=418)
